description: User can change a task's priority on the edit screen
objective: On https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/ — Step 1 (SETUP): create a task titled 'Priority demo task' with due date 2026-05-20 using the Add a task form. Step 2 (VERIFY): click the Edit link on that task's row, change its priority to High on the edit screen, and save. Step 3 (VERIFY): confirm the task list shows 'Priority demo task' with a High priority chip. Stay on the AUT - do NOT navigate to any kaneai-playground or ecommerce-playground site.
